data.content_ref: inline:Replace edge-addition enrichment with edge-pruning enrichment: a polynomial-time function deletes an attack A→B when there exists a committed warrant W and a rebuttal hyperedge (W,A) that is itself undefeated in the original graph; the grounded extension is then computed on the pruned graph. Determinism is preserved by making pruning a deterministic function of the original graph and committed roots; reinstatement remains derived because pruning only removes attacks, never labels. Criticizable because pruning can remove the only attack keeping an uncommitted node out, so validity of committed roots must be separately verified.
